ns2:course.label: Agric & Biological Engrg I
ns2:course.description: Engineering methods used in the design and management of agricultural, biological and environmental systems. Hydrologic cycle, soil-water properties and relationships, water runoff, surveying, soil erosion, water management, engine power, fluid power, traction and weight transfer, and off-road vehicle systems. Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
